title: relay_queue: serde_json error stringified into io::Error
description: relay_queue.rs line 152: serde_json::to_vec error is converted via .to_string() before being wrapped in std::io::Error::new. serde_json::Error implements Error + Send + Sync so it satisfies io::Error::new's Into<Box<dyn Error+Send+Sync>> bound directly. The .to_string() call loses the structured error type unnecessarily.
